messages:
amy_sales: FYI — Acme legal pushed for a signed DPA + current SCCs before we share POC creds. They also asked for a completed SIG/CAIQ, a DSAR/deletion runbook, and confirmation on subprocessors. Timeline: they want the POC next week. Can security/privacy own answers? /cc @liz_privacy @omar_security

liz_privacy: We have a standard DPA + EU SCC Annex that is redline-friendly. Important: customer needs to confirm role (controller vs processor). For POC we use the 'processor' template. I will attach the DPA link: https://internal.redwood/legal/dpa-template

omar_security: We can fill the CAIQ/SIG. Sam, can you provide the POC architecture diagram (where customer data flows) so we can mark scope (no logs persisted, KV cache redaction, encryption at rest)?

sam_solutions: Quick sketch inline:
```
PoC model calls -> Redwood hosted API (org-key isolation) -> optional Dedicated pool
Client-side redaction/pseudonymization before sending
Deletion endpoint: POST /v1/orgs/:org_id/data-deletion {"user_id": ...}
```
I'll drop a proper diagram in Drive.

liz_privacy: For DSARs we recommend this runbook: 1) verify requester identity 2) export artifacts 3) delete PII via deletion API 4) confirm with customer. We have a sample PR/template for CS: https://internal.redwood/privacy/dsar-runbook

omar_security: Answers summary for SIG/CAIQ for the POC scope: "No customer raw audio stored"; "KV caches encrypted at rest"; "KMS available, customer-managed keys supported on Dedicated/Private"; "Access logging retained 90 days by default, can be shortened for POC". I'll produce a one-pager with exact CAIQ booleans.

sec-bot: [audit] SIG questionnaire v1.4 generated by omar_security at 1812346120

amy_sales: Can we shorten retention to 7 days for the POC? Acme insists on minimal retention for their security review.

omar_security: Yes — we can configure access/log retention to 7 days for a Dedicated POC org. Note: hosted multitenant logs can be filtered by org but are not physically separated; Dedicated/Private is required for stronger guarantees.

liz_privacy: Contract note: SCCs require a subprocessors list and data transfer mechanisms. We publish subprocessors on the compliance page; I'll pull the current list and confirm. Also we should flag that SCCs may require Annex and signatures.

sam_solutions: To reduce risk during the POC we can recommend client-side pseudonymization: drop email/phone and send a synthetic_id. That minimizes PII and makes DSAR scope smaller.

amy_sales: Acme legal asked whether DSAR deletion requests pass through Redwood or the customer app. Short answer: Redwood exposes org-level deletion APIs and can wire an automated DSAR webhook for the customer. Anyone want to propose wording for the email?

liz_privacy: Draft wording: "Redwood provides org-level deletion APIs and supports automated DSAR workflows via webhook or manual export. For PII retention, default logs are 90 days; cached model KV entries are ephemeral and purged on deletion. For strict isolation or customer-managed keys please consider Dedicated or Private deployments." I'll paste a full draft into the drive link.

omar_security: Technical blocker to flag: EU SCCs + transfer mechanisms may require use of the 2021 SCCs with annex; our legal may need to sign. If Acme wants customer-managed keys, Private deployment is the route.

amy_sales: Can you both (liz/omar) post the DPA link + completed SIG/CAIQ PDF by EOD? I'll share with Acme legal and ask for greenlight.

jordan_cust_success: I'll prep the purchaser checklist and coordinate the legal sync on our side. Also confirm: provisioning timeline for Dedicated if they pick that? Sam?

sam_solutions: Dedicated small pool: ~7 business days after contract + infra commit. Private/on-prem: typically 4+ weeks.

amy_sales: Perfect. Closing loop — sending to Acme after we get DPA + SIG. Thanks team :pray:
